## 99 · ERROR HANDLER
Set this workflow as the **Error Workflow** on 00 / 10 / 20 / 30 / 40
(Workflow menu → Settings → Error Workflow). It fires automatically
whenever any of them throws.

It classifies the failure so whoever is on call knows what to do:
* `critical` — credentials, or a merge that may have half-applied → @here
* `error` — logic/data problem → fix and re-run
* `warning` — rate limit or transient network → safe to re-run as is

**Change `#crm-hygiene-alerts`** in both Slack nodes to the client's channel.
